layout_decisions: The existing organization and team folder contain three sibling projects: foundation, dev, and staging; organization/folder creation and policy changes are out of scope.
Dev and staging projects are stacked vertically to keep the factory fan-out short and preserve a separate per-environment IAM and workload panel.
Terraform setup uses one blue trunk that branches to the two actual environment projects; log sinks merge at a junction only because both route to the same central bucket.
The Terraform state route and the log routing route use separate gutters; no connector crosses a service label or unrelated resource.
Cloud Run workloads are regional in asia-southeast1; project boundaries remain global. The billing account is shown as an existing operator input, not nested inside the resource hierarchy.
The project seeder and keyless environment-factory identity are distinct phases; the Project Creator's automatic Owner grant is removed during handoff.
